scientific_integrity: A mathematical claim with a self-contained block factorization and explicit finite polynomial identities. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple cactus graphs only
Two vertex-pair connectivity indicators, not arbitrary increasing events
Does not cover general graphs or \(q>0\) random-cluster laws
Full original HTML of the motivating 2026 preprint was inspected, but the older connectivity-focused thesis was not accessible in full for novelty comparison
title: Positive connectivity correlations for weighted forests on cactus graphs
